skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Execute a written implementation plan in small batches, with critical review and checkpoints between batches.
skill.summary: Guides plan-driven implementation with batch execution, verification, and review pauses.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or unsafe execution instructions.

content.value_statement: Implementation plans can drift when long tasks run without checkpoints. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through batch execution with review pauses.
actual_capabilities: Reads a written plan before starting implementation.
Reviews the plan for questions, gaps, and concerns.
Executes tasks in small batches, starting with three tasks by default.
Runs the verifications specified by the plan.
Reports implemented work and verification output after each batch.
Stops and asks for help when blockers or repeated failures appear.
limitations: Requires a written implementation plan to be useful.
Does not define the technical plan for the user.
Depends on available project tests and verification commands.
References a separate finishing workflow for final branch completion.

use_cases.title: Execute Ticket Plans
use_cases.description: A developer uses the skill to implement a prepared ticket plan while preserving review checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Review Agent Progress
use_cases.description: A lead reviews completed batches before the agent continues with the next implementation tasks.

use_cases.title: Control Complex Changes
use_cases.description: A maintainer keeps multi-step changes organized with verification output after each batch.

prompt_templates.title: Run A Simple Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use executing-plans to review and execute the plan at [plan path]. Stop after the first batch and report verification results.

prompt_templates.title: Check The Plan First
prompt_templates.prompt: Use executing-plans with [plan path]. Review the plan for unclear steps or risky assumptions before editing files.

prompt_templates.title: Execute With Custom Batch Size
prompt_templates.scenario: Controlled progress on a larger plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use executing-plans for [plan path]. Execute two tasks per batch, run listed verifications, and wait for feedback after each batch.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate A High Risk Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use executing-plans for [plan path]. Call out architectural concerns first, execute only approved batches, and stop on failed verification.

output_examples.input: Execute the account settings plan and pause after the first batch.
output_examples.output: The agent reviews the plan, completes the first three tasks, runs the specified checks, and reports results for review.

output_examples.input: The plan may have missing migration details.
output_examples.output: The agent raises the gap before implementation and asks for clarification instead of guessing.

output_examples.input: Continue with the next approved batch.
output_examples.output: The agent updates task status, implements the next batch, verifies the work, and waits for feedback.

best_practices: Provide a clear plan file with small, testable tasks.
Include verification commands for each implementation area.
Review batch reports before approving additional work.
anti_patterns: Using the skill without a written plan.
Forcing progress when instructions are unclear or tests repeatedly fail.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an AI agent execute a written implementation plan in batches with review checkpoints.

faq.question: Does it create the plan?
faq.answer: No. It expects a plan to already exist before execution starts.

faq.question: How many tasks are executed first?
faq.answer: The default first batch is three tasks unless the user or plan says otherwise.

faq.question: When does the agent stop?
faq.answer: It stops when blockers, unclear instructions, missing dependencies, or repeated verification failures appear.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is executable code included?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a Markdown instruction file and does not include scripts or runtime code.
